::: {.product-interpretation}
Last-freeze dates are compared with the censoring-aware 1991-2020 median; negative means early and positive means late. Before July 31, departures require the median date to have passed and 14 freeze-free days; gray marks the season in progress, and later freezes can change provisional results.
:::
